# Samantha Breathwork

> One-on-one online breathwork sessions for women with chronic anxiety, by Samantha, a breathwork and anxiety coach (trauma-informed breathwork certification, NLP certification, 150+ women supported over 5 years). Sessions are 90 minutes, by video only, in English or French, for clients in Australia and Europe. A first 30-minute discovery call is free.

Samantha works online only: there is no studio or in-person option. Prices are $150 AUD / 90 € for a single session, with packs of 3, 5 and a 12-session program. Breathwork is offered alongside medical or psychological care, never as a replacement, and is not suitable during pregnancy or with epilepsy, cardiovascular conditions, glaucoma or severe psychiatric conditions.
